description:

At the 4⭐ Superior Estival Torrequebrada Grand Hotel ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Are you ready to experience dance to the fullest? 💃🕺
🎟️ FULL PASS ONLY — All-access ticket to an unforgettable experience:
✨ Workshops with top-tier artists, both national and international✨ Shows that will leave you speechless.
✨ Social dancing until your body can’t take it anymoreConnect, learn, and feel the energy of the congress surrounded by dancers from all over the world 🌍🔥
🎟️🏨🔥 FULL PASS + HOTEL – Málaga Dance Congress 2027
Do you want the full experience WITHOUT worrying about anything? 😏The Málaga Dance Congress has exactly what you need!!
💥 TOTAL access to the congress
💥 Spectacular 4⭐ superior hotel included
💥 More comfort, more connection, more party, dance, rest, and get back on the floor without missing a second ⚡
💥 In a unique setting with top-class facilities: Spa, casino, gym, top-quality gastronomy, and incredible rooms.Plus, easy parking 🅿️ with both free and paid options, and public transport right at the door.
What else could you ask for?👉 Everything in one package. You just have to come and enjoy. Are you going to miss it?
